text: A hyperrealistic, cinematic fantasy portrait of a seductive, aristocratic vampire woman lounging in an ornate black marble bathtub filled with crimson blood. She has long, flowing, glossy black curls cascading over her shoulders and down her back, framing her face. Her skin is flawless, pale as moonlight, glistening subtly with moisture from the bathwater. Her eyes are half-closed in languid ecstasy, lips parted to reveal sharp, fang-like teeth — a classic vampire aesthetic. She wears elaborate gothic jewelry: an ornate choker necklace with red gemstones and dangling pendants, multiple layered necklaces, and intricate gold bracelets on her wrist. She is reclining gracefully, one arm resting along the edge of the tub, the other draped casually over her thigh. Her body is fully exposed — naturalistic, curvaceous, and beautifully proportioned — bathed in soft, moody lighting from surrounding candlelight. The bathtub itself is luxurious, made of polished black marble with golden veins, featuring a vintage brass faucet and spout. Floating on the surface of the blood-red water are several elegant, wilted black roses. The setting is an opulent, gothic-style bathroom or private chamber — richly decorated with dark wood paneling adorned with gilded carvings and ornate mirrors. In the background, multiple candelabras with lit white candles cast a warm, flickering glow that creates soft shadows and enhances the mysterious, luxurious atmosphere. Heavy velvet curtains in deep burgundy hang beside tall windows or arched doorways — one window reveals a blurred view of stone architecture outside, hinting at an old castle or mansion. A single elegant wine glass filled with dark red liquid (likely blood-red wine) sits on the edge of the tub near her hand, catching the candlelight. The floor is covered in intricate black and gold patterned tiles, adding to the decadent ambiance. The overall mood is sensual, mysterious, and slightly sinister — a blend of gothic romance and vampiric allure. Ultra-detailed, 8K resolution, photorealistic, dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, cinematic composition with shallow depth of field, rich textures (marble, velvet, skin, metal), color palette dominated by deep reds, blacks, golds, and warm candlelight tones.
